articles.title: Polymarket targets $20 billion valuation as competition heats up in prediction market sector
articles.snippet: The blockchain-based prediction markets platform is reportedly returning to investors months after a $15 billion funding round.

articles.title: BlackRock debuts tokenized access to $311 billion of money market funds in Europe
articles.snippet: Earlier this week, BlackRock expanded its U.S. tokenized cash platform which involved offering onchain shares of an existing fund, plus a new daily reinvestment stablecoin fund.

articles.title: A bitcoin wallet dormant since 2013 moved $31 million, and it's not the only one
articles.snippet: A 12-year-old bitcoin wallet moved $31 million on Monday, part of a broader wave of dormant coins shifting since the Coldcard hack.

articles.title: Texas electric grid moratorium won’t have big impact on BTC miners: Bernstein
articles.snippet: Monday’s announcement that Texas Governor Greg Abbott set a moratorium on approval of ERCOT-linked data centers pending an audit won’t impact miners’ approved electricity contracts.

articles.title: BlackRock launches tokenized money market funds for stablecoin reserves
articles.snippet: The asset manager introduced two blockchain-based money market funds designed to qualify as stablecoin reserve assets under the US GENIUS Act.
